rules.requirement: Every library-native + antd project has zero deprecated API findings for the frozen runtime version.
A controlled Upload fileList declares onChange and preserves a stable per-file lifecycle.
getContainer must not create a new DOM node during render or on each callback invocation.
Direct imports of message and notification static APIs, and Modal static methods, are rejected in favor of App or hook context.

rules.enforcement: Design audit until all selected components expose a frozen semantic map
rules.requirement: Use semantic classNames and styles or component tokens before selectors coupled to AntD internal DOM structure.
